registryEvidence.custodian: Alcaldía del Municipio Cabimas, Oficina de Catastro / Servicio Desconcentrado Bolivariano de Administración Tributaria de Cabimas (SIGAT)
registryEvidence.basis: The first-party SIGAT site identifies the municipal tax administration; its official ordinance requires a current constancia de inscripción catastral and refers to the Registro Inmobiliario competent for Cabimas. A municipal management document describes the Oficina de Catastro and cadastral forms.

officialSources.observation: Official Cabimas municipal SIGAT site; identifies the municipal tax administration and links the public contributor portal.
officialSources.scope: Cabimas municipal administration; no parcel geometry exposed on the landing page.

officialSources.observation: Officially hosted ordinance requires cadastral registration/constancia and references the competent Registro Inmobiliario; it is legal/procedural evidence, not an open parcel dataset.
officialSources.scope: Municipio Cabimas urban-property tax and cadastral procedure.

officialSources.observation: Current public Angular contributor portal; its JavaScript configuration sets apiUrl=/api/v1 and exposes a cadastral-code lookup route.
officialSources.scope: Cabimas contributor service; lookup is not a public parcel geometry API.

requests.outcome: Fetched official municipal SIGAT landing page and followed its contributor portal link.
Fetched public Angular portal shell and inspected current JavaScript/configuration.
Inspected current bundle: apiUrl=/api/v1; cadastral lookup route is /contribuyente/alcaldias/{id}/catastro?cod=...; no map/WMS/WFS geometry route was exposed.
Guessed portal metadata route returned 404; not treated as evidence of cadastral absence.
Anonymous cadastral-code lookup was forbidden; no credentials, token, CAPTCHA bypass, or unsafe field request was attempted.
Second bounded anonymous lookup was forbidden; not treated as citywide absence.

source: Cabimas SIGAT municipal site and contributor portal

coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: No anonymous parcel geometry or safe ID+geometry response was verified.

remainingUncertainty: A local municipal cadastral custodian is evidenced, but the public portal requires an authenticated cadastral lookup and exposes no verified anonymous parcel geometry route. Exact-point absence, map extent, and citywide availability were not inferred.
